metadata.title: उड़द के कुरकुरा वड़ा बनाने का आदिवासी तरीक़ा । Adivasi Dal Vada Recipe ।The Tribal Kitchen
metadata.description:
The Main Bhi Bharat team revisited a Barela Adivasi family after a gap of 6 years in a small village of Bhagwanpura block in Madhya Pradesh. The family gave us a warm welcome and cooked for us a dish that is made on special occasions.

#wada_recipe #wada #daal_wada
